info.title: Aethera API
info.description: REST API of the Aethera control plane. Conventions: docs/architecture/0003-api-conventions.md.

get.description: True only while no user exists. The UI uses it to decide between the setup form and the login form.

post.description: Creates the default organization, the first user and an Owner membership in one transaction, signs the user in (sets the session cookie) and returns the same body as GET /auth/me. Works only while no user exists, however many requests race.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Sets the session cookie and returns the same body as GET /auth/me. Unknown email and wrong password are indistinguishable (auth.invalid_credentials). After repeated failures the account is locked (auth.locked_out with retryAfter seconds). Rate limited per client IP.

423.description: Account locked after repeated failures (auth.locked_out); retryAfter and Retry-After give the seconds left.

429.description: Too many attempts from this IP (rate_limited); Retry-After gives the seconds.

post.description: Revokes the current browser session and clears the cookie. With an API token there is no session, so nothing happens.

403.description: Missing or wrong X-CSRF-Token on a session request (auth.csrf_invalid).

get.summary: The current user, organization and role
get.description: Works for browser sessions and API tokens; for a token it describes the token's owner.

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

get.summary: CSRF token for the current session
get.description: Send the value in the X-CSRF-Token header of every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE made with the session cookie. The token is bound to the session and changes at the next login.

403.description: Called with an API token, which has no session (auth.forbidden).

post.description: Needs a browser session and the current password. All other sessions of the user are revoked. Wrong current passwords count towards the account lockout.

403.description: An API token was used (auth.forbidden) or the CSRF token is missing (auth.csrf_invalid).

422.description: Policy violation or wrong current password (validation.failed; errors[] codes too_short, too_long, password.same_as_email, incorrect).

423.description: Account locked after repeated wrong current passwords (auth.locked_out).

get.description: Admin role (the `admin` scope for API tokens). Filters: `role` (comma-separated), `isActive`, `q` (substring of email or name). Sort: `email` (default) or `createdAt`, optionally prefixed with `-`.

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

post.summary: Create a user with an initial password
post.description: Admin role (the `admin` scope for API tokens). Only an Owner can create an Owner.

403.description: Role too low, only an owner can grant the owner role (auth.forbidden), or the CSRF token is missing (auth.csrf_invalid).

get.description: Admin role (the `admin` scope for API tokens).

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

404.description: No such user in this organization (user.not_found).

patch.description: Admin role (the `admin` scope for API tokens). Change `email` or `displayName`, deactivate or reactivate with `isActive`, or reset the password with `password` (which signs the user out everywhere). Only an Owner can change an Owner, and the last active Owner cannot be deactivated.

403.description: Only an owner can change an owner (auth.forbidden), or the CSRF token is missing (auth.csrf_invalid).

409.description: Email already in use (user.already_exists) or this would leave no active owner (users.last_owner).

delete.description: Admin role (the `admin` scope for API tokens). Soft delete: the account, its sessions and its API tokens stop working and the email address is freed. The last active Owner cannot be deleted.

403.description: Only an owner can delete an owner (auth.forbidden), or the CSRF token is missing (auth.csrf_invalid).

409.description: The last active owner cannot be removed (users.last_owner).

put.description: Admin role (the `admin` scope for API tokens). Only an Owner can grant the Owner role or change an Owner's role. The last active Owner cannot be demoted.

403.description: Only an owner can grant or change the owner role (auth.forbidden), or the CSRF token is missing (auth.csrf_invalid).

409.description: This would leave no active owner (users.last_owner).

get.description: Your own tokens; Admin and Owner see every token of the organization and can narrow with `userId`. Filter `status`: `active`, `revoked`, `expired` (comma-separated). Newest first. The secret is never returned.

403.description: Asked for another user's tokens without being an admin (auth.forbidden).

post.description: Creates a token for yourself. **The plaintext `token` is returned only in this response**; store it now. Scopes cannot exceed what your role allows: viewer `read`; developer adds `write` and `deploy`; admin and owner everything. `expiresAt` defaults to 90 days, may be at most one year ahead, and may be `null` (never) for admin and owner only. With an API token this needs the `admin` scope.

403.description: The CSRF token is missing on a session request (auth.csrf_invalid) or the API token lacks the admin scope (auth.insufficient_scope).

422.description: Invalid input (validation.failed; errors[] codes required, invalid_scope, scope_not_allowed, never_not_allowed, in_past, too_far).

get.description: Your own token, or any token of the organization for Admin and Owner. Never includes the secret.

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

404.description: No such token, or it belongs to someone else (api_token.not_found).

delete.description: Takes effect immediately; the token row stays (with `revokedAt`) so history remains. Revoking twice is fine. Your own token, or any token of the organization for Admin and Owner. With an API token this needs the `admin` scope.

403.description: The CSRF token is missing on a session request (auth.csrf_invalid).

404.description: No such token, or it belongs to someone else (api_token.not_found).

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).
Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

get.summary: Read a job's log, paged by sequence, or download it as text
get.description: JSON pages by default (`fromSequence`, `limit`). With `download=true` the whole log from `fromSequence` is streamed as `text/plain`.

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

post.description: A queued job is cancelled immediately; a running job is asked to stop and ends cancelled within one heartbeat.

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

post.summary: Retry a failed or cancelled job
post.description: Creates a new job linked to the original (`parentJobId`); the original stays as it is.

403.description: Role or token scope insufficient (auth.forbidden, auth.insufficient_scope).

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the offending body member, e.g. /domains/0/host.

parameter.description: Name of the offending query or path parameter.

code.description: Short stable validator id: required, too_long, too_short, pattern, range, invalid_enum, not_unique, or a domain-specific code.

FieldError.description: One field-level problem. Exactly one of pointer (JSON Pointer into the body) or parameter (query/path) is set.

title.description: Short fixed phrase per code. Do not parse.

detail.description: Occurrence-specific text for humans. Do not parse.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, area.reason. Clients branch on this. Resource-specific codes (<resource>.not_found, <resource>.already_exists) are open-ended.

traceId.description: The X-Request-Id of the failed request.

traceId.description: The X-Request-Id of the failed request.

ValidationProblem.description: RFC 9457 problem with field-level errors (422, and 400 for invalid parameters).

cookieAuth.description: Browser session. Unsafe methods must also send the X-CSRF-Token header (GET /auth/csrf).
cookieAuth.name: __Host-aethera_session

bearerAuth.description: API token: Authorization: Bearer aeth_... Its scopes are listed per operation as x-required-scope.
